featured_reviews.name: ashwini mohekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tasteless food, please don’t waste money by ordering from them. Also they have another business with the name of Shiv Sagar Caterers & Mandap Decorator, so make sure u don’t order from them as well. I ordered pulav kadhi n hara bhara kebab which was so tasteless that my guest also went without eating. Kebab were only potato's. They didn’t even apologise for this but were stubborn that pulav means only beans n carrots in rice.

ONW OWNER RUNS BOTH CATERING BUSINESS
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Ashwini mohekar,

Firstly, I deeply regret that you had an unsatisfactory experience with our food and service. At Annapurna Caterers and mandap decorator, we take pride in delivering quality cuisine, and it's disheartening to hear when we don’t meet those expectations.

Regarding your feedback on the pulav and kebab, I appreciate your input and we will certainly review and improve upon those dishes. As ordered it was a plain Pulav not spicy one, Pulav variations differ, but it's essential that the customer feels content with their order. 

I'd like to clarify that while we may have affiliations with Shiv Sagar Caterers & Mandap Decorator, both businesses strive to uphold high standards. I apologize if we failed to convey that during our previous interaction.

I understand that an apology might not change your experience, but I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss this further and perhaps rectify the situation. Your feedback is invaluable, and I genuinely hope we can earn back your trust in the future.

Warm regards,



Ranglal Rajpurohit,
Annapurna Caterers & Mandap Decorator

featured_reviews.review_text: We had planned a housewarming ceremony for few guests in November, 2020.
